fields.label: Storefront
fields.description: Storefront ID or name in the target system. Resolved against the chosen backend's storefront table at sync time.

fields.label: Aktiv
fields.description: When disabled, this sync target is skipped.

fields.label: Sichtbarkeit
fields.options:
All (30)
Linked Only (20)
Search Only (10)
Hidden (0)
fields.description: Shopware switch. 30 - All = visible everywhere. 20 - Linked = direct link only. 10 - Search = search only. 0 - Hidden = not visible. Medusa treats everything except 'Hidden' as visible.

fields.label: Add only, never remove
fields.description: When enabled: the sync only adds items to the backend category. Items already there but not matching the rule result are left alone. Useful when linking to a manually curated category.

fields.label: Backend-ID
fields.description: Backend category ID. Auto-filled after the first successful sync.

fields.label: Letzte Synchronisation (informativ)
fields.description: Timestamp of the last successful sync for this target.

fields.label: Letzter Heartbeat (informativ)
fields.description: Updated at the start of every sync attempt. Stale-target-recover removes rows stuck in 'running' for too long.

fields.label: Last error message (informational)
fields.description: Short summary; full stacktrace in the Ecommerce Integration Log.
